# IOSlaveProcessor

Une extension du noyau de la pile du coprocesseur.

Chaque entrée est une fonction ou une table lue dans le binaire décompilé. Elle consigne ce qui a été lu, avec son statut ; aucun code d'Apple n'est stocké ici. Les notes elles-mêmes sont rédigées en anglais.

## class tables survey (pointer tables, destructor sizes, metaclass arguments)

Relecture : partial · 4 affirmations · 3 questions ouvertes

- **IOSLAVE-TABLES-001** (device disassembly verified): FACTS. In the second entry of each instance table of this kext, the size passed to the delete call is 8 (table 0x8039a4cc), 0x10 (0x80399c88), 0x38 (0x8039a588), 0x50 (0x80399d48 and 0x8039a110) and 0x68 (0x8039a678).
- **IOSLAVE-TABLES-002** (device disassembly verified): FACT. Three functions at 0x80399728, 0x8039974c and 0x80399764 store the table 0x8039a678 and then call a base function (the pattern of destructors), and the first passes 0x68 to a delete call.
- **IOSLAVE-TABLES-004** (hypothesis): CANDIDATE ATTRIBUTION, not confirmed.
- **IOSLAVE-TABLES-003** (device disassembly verified): The module init passes, as superclass metaclass object, the same kernel address 0x802d38b4 for IOSlaveCPU, IOSlaveFirmware and IOSlaveProcessor (so they are siblings under it, not derived from each other), 0x802d3600 for IOSlaveM…

- *Ouverte* **IOSLAVE-TABLES-Q1**: Which of the two 80-byte instance tables (0x80399d48, 0x8039a110) is IOSlaveCPU and which is IOSlaveFirmware: 0x8039a110 is installed by the constructor that IOP_s5l8920x_firmware calls (0x803997c5), which supports Firmware; IOSl…
- *Ouverte* **IOSLAVE-TABLES-Q2**: The entry at offset +0x44 of the CPU, Firmware and Processor metaclass tables returns 0 (0x80399058, 0x8039904c, 0x80399028).
- *Ouverte* **IOSLAVE-TABLES-Q3**: Tables are delimited by runs of pointers, not from a located vtable header; the delete sizes were read from only the second entry of each.

[Fiche complète](https://github.com/SebE585/trognon/blob/main/tools/iop_analysis/catalog/IOSlaveProcessor/class_tables.yaml)

## field_0x58_getter (working name, not Apple's)

Entrée `0x8039901c` · Relecture : complete · 1 affirmation · 1 question ouverte

- **IOSLAVE-GETTER-001** (device disassembly verified): A two-byte-instruction function that returns the 32-bit field at offset +0x58 of its object (ldr r0,[r0,#0x58]; bx lr).

- *Ouverte* **IOSLAVE-GETTER-Q2**: Body of 0x801bcd68, the +0x34c entry of the abstract IOSlaveFirmware and IOSlaveCPU tables of this kext.

[Fiche complète](https://github.com/SebE585/trognon/blob/main/tools/iop_analysis/catalog/IOSlaveProcessor/getter_0x8039901c.yaml)

## module init (OSMetaClass registration loop)

Entrée `0x80399594` · Relecture : complete · 2 affirmations · 2 questions ouvertes

- **IOSLAVE-INIT-001** (device disassembly verified): This kext's module-load code registers six OSMetaClass instances -- IOSlaveMemory (8), IOSlaveMemoryBuffer (16), IOSlaveEndpoint (56), IOSlaveCPU (80), IOSlaveFirmware (80), IOSlaveProcessor (104) bytes -- each size read as a lit…
- **IOSLAVE-INIT-002** (device disassembly verified): No loading/firmware logic found within the reviewed_ranges above (the init loop and the six constructor-call sites, ~230 of this kext's 2968 __text bytes).

- *Ouverte* **IOSLAVE-INIT-Q1**: the six tiny 'alloc' functions (0x80399a44 etc., 14 bytes each) not individually read, assumed to be generic OSObject::new-style allocators from their call position -- not verified
- *Ouverte* **IOSLAVE-INIT-Q2**: 0x80399848/0x803998c0/0x803998d8/0x80399900 (seen in the function list, not examined) -- role unknown

[Fiche complète](https://github.com/SebE585/trognon/blob/main/tools/iop_analysis/catalog/IOSlaveProcessor/module_init.yaml)
